topics.label: Introduction to the Hallmarks of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the learning objectives and framing tumor progression through Hanahan and Weinberg's cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Proliferative and Growth-Inhibitory Signaling Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinases, Wnt/beta-catenin, and TGF-beta cascades drive sustained proliferation and overcome inhibitory growth signals.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how malignant cells in hematopoietic lineages and the intestinal epithelium arrest normal terminal differentiation to preserve a proliferative progenitor state.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through p53 mutations and the deregulation of pro- and anti-apoptotic mitochondrial factors.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Evasion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells overcome telomere shortening and p53-mediated senescence to achieve replicative immortality, concluding the discussion of mutation-driven growth control hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulating Cellular Metabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells rewire metabolic pathways toward aerobic glycolysis and produce oncometabolites through Krebs cycle mutations that alter the epigenome.

topics.label: Inducing Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore why expanding tumors require new blood vessel formation to overcome hypoxia, detailing the timing and regulatory balance of the angiogenic switch.

topics.label: Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the multistep dissemination of cancer cells through the circulation, the physical and microenvironmental barriers to colonization, and the lack of discrete metastatic driver mutations.

topics.label: Lecture Wrap-Up and Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with reflections on recent hallmark literature, a summary of key concepts, and practical session housekeeping.
